title: gatk pipeline parameters
description: GATK germline short-variant calling pipeline: BWA alignment, HaplotypeCaller, GenomicsDBImport, GenotypeGVCFs

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_data_dir.description: Directory containing input data and cached genome indices (e.g. 'indices/<reference>.{amb,ann,bwt,pac,sa}').

reference.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA file.
reference.errorMessage: Reference file must have extension '.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna' (optionally gzipped), cannot contain spaces, and must exist.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet listing samples and their FASTQ file paths (columns: sample,fastq_1,fastq_2). Each row is validated against assets/schema_input.json.
input.errorMessage: Samplesheet must be an existing CSV file, cannot contain spaces.

intervals.description: Interval(s) passed to GATK GenomicsDBImport when aggregating GVCFs. Example: 'chr20' or 'chr1,chr2'.
